exercises.instructions: Rewrite the following sentences using 'as soon as'.

questions.question: He finished his work. He went out immediately. Rewrite using 'as soon as'.

He went out as soon as finished his work he
As soon as he went out, he finished his work
questions.answer: As soon as he finished his work, he went out
questions.explanation: Place 'As soon as' before the first action (finished his work), then the second action after the comma. 'As soon as' ကို ပထမ action ရှေ့မှာ ထားပါ။
